shared_elements: standing human or humanoid figure in profile
figure with raised arm holding an object
low-relief incised linear detailing of garments/hair
justification: Both show incised low-relief standing figures in profile with raised arm holding a small object, rendered with dense linear patterning of hair and garment, and both include stylized plant-like elements. But A is a single large winged, bearded figure among branching palmette/rosette plants filling the field, while B is a multi-register composition of several small facing figures around altar-like objects and columns of sign-like marks, with no wings and a wholly different compositional scheme.
